shorts_extract.hook: At age 26, Carl Wernicke found the mirror-twin of Broca's aphasia and sketched history's first connectome diagram of human language.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Wernicke (1874): fluent paraphasic speech + lost comprehension from left posterior temporal lesions + predicting Conduction Aphasia.
shorts_extract.twist: Binder's (2015) MRI breakthrough: why pSTG is the phonological decoder & live headphone monitor while word meaning spans wider temporal cortex.
